title: Boolean complete quadratic function
statement: For each nonnegative integer $n$, define a Boolean function on $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ by converting each input to its corresponding vector in $\\mathbb F_2^n$, evaluating the complete quadratic bit, and encoding the result as a sign in $\\{-1,1\\}$.
